meta.source: NASA POWER monthly point API (MERRA-2 derived) and Meteomatics

T2M.label: Temperature at 2 m
T2M.description: Annual mean air temperature two metres above the surface. Use for warming, heat, and cooling questions at a place.
T2M.keywords: temperature temp warming warmed warm heat hot cold climate air degrees

PRECTOTCORR.label: Precipitation (corrected)
PRECTOTCORR.description: Annual mean precipitation rate. Use for rain, rainfall, drying, drought, and wetting questions at a place.
PRECTOTCORR.keywords: rain rainfall raining precipitation dry drier drying drought wet wetter monsoon storm water

GWETROOT.label: Root-zone soil wetness
GWETROOT.description: Annual mean root-zone soil wetness. Use for soil moisture, agricultural drought, and land drying questions.
GWETROOT.keywords: soil moisture wetness drought agriculture land dryness dry drier declining groundwater root zone

ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN.label: Surface solar irradiance
ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN.description: Annual mean all-sky downward shortwave radiation at the surface. Use for sunlight, solar, cloudiness, and radiation questions.
ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN.keywords: solar sunlight radiation sunshine irradiance cloud cloudiness energy bright brighter dimmer
